name: AI System Evaluation
description: Design and execute use-case-specific TEVV for models and agentic systems with blind data, valid metrics, adversarial cases, uncertainty, and reproducible reporting.

tasks.name: Define evaluation objectives
tasks.objective: Specify intended use, users, environment, decision consequences, required capabilities, unacceptable failures, populations, and measurement claims the evaluation must support.

tasks.name: Design evaluation suite
tasks.objective: Choose representative and stress-test tasks, blind or sequestered data where possible, baselines, human references, subgroup slices, adversarial cases, contamination controls, and metrics tied to the actual use case.

tasks.name: Freeze protocol
tasks.objective: Freeze prompts/system settings, tool access, sampling parameters, scoring code, evaluator instructions, stopping rules, model/version identifiers, and environment before test execution; separate tuning data from final evaluation.

tasks.name: Run and capture traces
tasks.objective: Execute reproducibly, retaining inputs, outputs, tool/action traces, latency, costs/resources, refusals, errors, and evaluator annotations without silently retrying failures away.

tasks.name: Analyze performance and uncertainty
tasks.objective: Estimate task-level and generalized performance with appropriate uncertainty, subgroup/error distributions, calibration where relevant, robustness, cost/latency tradeoffs, and sensitivity to prompts or evaluator choices.

tasks.name: Adversarial and real-world validation
tasks.objective: Test edge cases, distribution shift, prompt injection/tool misuse for agents, long-horizon compounding errors, and realistic workflows; compare benchmark success to real outcome success.

tasks.name: Publish evaluation report
tasks.objective: Report objectives, dataset/task provenance, model/config versions, protocol, metrics, uncertainty, failures, subgroup results, limitations, reproducibility artifacts, and claims the evidence does and does not support.
